item.title: SimCity Creator Will Wright Unveils AI Memory Game MyMems
item.description:
Will Wright, creator of SimCity and The Sims, has announced MyMems, a mobile social simulation developed by Gallium Studios. Players speak personal stories into their phones, and AI turns them into placeable map pieces and avatars of real people, gradually building a world that maps the player's psyche.

原文标题：《模拟城市》之父新作 MyMems 用 AI 将记忆变成游戏世界

Why it matters：知名游戏设计师将生成式 AI 引入个人记忆驱动的社交模拟玩法，是 AI 消费级应用的一次有趣探索。

item.title: KPMG Runs First Parallel Audit With 100 AI Agents
item.description:
KPMG ran its first full AI-powered parallel audit of a FTSE 250 company, deploying more than 100 agents across every phase of the annual audit. The agents dug deeper into individual questions than the regular team, though a human had to step in when an agent tried to match regulations against company documents, and the official opinion remained grounded in the conventional audit.

原文标题：毕马威百个 AI 智能体完成首次平行审计

Why it matters：这是四大会计师事务所首次将上百个智能体投入真实审计全流程的公开案例，为智能体在强合规场景的落地边界提供了稀缺的一手证据。

item.title: Samsung Plans to Unveil Two Humanoid Robots at CES 2027
item.description:
Samsung Electronics plans to unveil two humanoid robots, HR and HE, at CES 2027, targeting entry-level and high-end segments respectively, with HE offering more degrees of freedom. Both feature five-finger hands and a cable-driven mechanism mimicking human tendons, signaling Samsung's push into embodied intelligence.

原文标题：三星计划 CES 2027 发布两款人形机器人

Why it matters：三星首次明确人形机器人产品线与发布时间节点，是具身智能赛道的重要产业动向。

item.title: AI-Written Referee Reports Threaten Peer Review, Economists Warn
item.description:
Economists from the Federal Reserve Board, University of Pennsylvania, CEPR and NBER warn that large language models can now write papers and referee reports, putting peer review at risk of collapse without new norms. Their experiment shows AI detectors flag reports written by AI but not those merely proofread or edited by it, and they argue AI-generated referee reports should be treated like plagiarism and rejected.

原文标题：研究警告 AI 生成审稿意见或致同行评审崩溃

Why it matters：直击 AI 对学术评审制度的系统性冲击，并给出可操作的检测与处置规范，对科研与出版生态读者高度相关。

item.title: Zhang Chaoyang Says Sohu Cannot Afford Large Model Race
item.description:
Sohu founder Charles Zhang again addressed claims that the company has gone quiet, saying large model investment is too costly for Sohu to pursue. He argued firms must match strategy to resources, noting Sohu is now focused on social products and that human connection remains the dominant internet need.

原文标题：张朝阳称大模型投入过大 搜狐无力跟进

Why it matters：国内老牌互联网公司明确表态退出大模型竞赛，是观察产业资源分化的一手信号。

item.title: AMD Adds Instinct MI450X Accelerator with 288GB HBM4 Memory
item.description:
AMD has expanded its Instinct MI400 lineup with the MI450X accelerator, which keeps the same core specs and compute as the MI455X but cuts memory from 432GB to 288GB of HBM4 while preserving peak bandwidth. The part targets workloads that fit its smaller memory footprint, aiming to cut operating costs while still meeting throughput and latency targets.

原文标题：AMD 推出 MI450X 加速器 显存降至 288GB HBM4

Why it matters：AMD 以削减显存的 SKU 细分 MI400 产品线，反映 AI 加速器按显存容量分档定价的竞争策略。

item.title: Tencent Expects AI Capex Efficiency Gains by 2028
item.description:
Tencent executives said on an earnings call that current capex is mainly directed at AI infrastructure, which is reusable rather than a one-off expense. Combined with falling hardware prices and rising training/inference efficiency, the company expects AI-related operating pressure to ease by 2028. Q3 2026 free cash flow was negative RMB 69.1 billion, largely due to RMB 65.1 billion in capex payments; excluding compute prepayments, free cash flow would turn positive at RMB 16.9 billion.

原文标题：腾讯预计 2028 年 AI 投入产出效率改善

Why it matters：腾讯首次给出 AI 资本开支回报的时间表判断，并披露算力预付款对现金流的实质影响，是观察中国大厂 AI 基建投入节奏的重要信号。

item.title: SEC Opens Probe Into Nvidia Over Undisclosed Chip Sales
item.description:
The SEC has opened a civil investigation into Nvidia over whether its Asian chip sales violated disclosure rules and misled investors. The probe centers on Nvidia's decision last year to stop breaking out Singapore revenue, tied to Megaspeed, a firm US intelligence links to Chinese intelligence. The Commerce Department, Congress and the Treasury Secretary are pressing in parallel, and Nvidia shares have fallen more than 10% since the crisis began.

原文标题：SEC 对英伟达展开芯片销售披露调查

Why it matters：监管调查叠加高管动荡，直接冲击全球最大 AI 算力供应商的合规与估值逻辑。

item.title: Nvidia Tightens Financing Guarantee Rules for Cloud Partners
item.description:
Nvidia CFO Colette Kress clarified on the quarterly earnings call that the company's loan guarantees for data center projects only take effect once customers have secured equity or debt financing and are ready to procure and install Nvidia equipment. She signaled stricter screening of guarantee recipients, suggesting the aggressive circular-investment style of the Jensen Huang era may be winding down.

原文标题：英伟达收紧云厂商融资担保规则

Why it matters：英伟达融资担保规则收紧直接关系 AI 数据中心资本循环与算力扩张节奏，是判断行业景气度的重要信号。

item.title: Pennsylvania High School Disables AI Weapon Detection System After False Alarms
item.description:
A Pennsylvania high school has disabled an AI weapon detection system after it repeatedly misidentified everyday items such as water bottles and binders as firearms. Developed by Carnegie Mellon spin-off CurvePoint, the Wi-Fi signal-based system fell far short of its 95% accuracy target, and the district will recover its equipment payment.

原文标题：误报频发 美国一高中停用 AI 武器探测系统

Why it matters：这是 AI 安防落地中误报率与可靠性问题的典型案例，对评估 AI 硬件部署边界有参考价值。

item.title: Arm China Unveils STAR 100e AIoT Prototype Platform
item.description:
Arm China launched the STAR 100e AIoT prototype platform, built on the Arm Cortex-M42 CPU paired with the Ethos-U55 NPU, and has validated keyword spotting, object recognition and speech recognition use cases on FPGA. The Cortex-M42 cuts silicon area by 10% and power by 15% versus the Cortex-M52 at comparable performance, while pairing with Ethos-U55 boosts speech recognition inference by over 340x.

原文标题：安谋科技发布星辰 100e AIoT 原型平台

Why it matters：面向成本敏感智能端点的新一代 MCU 与 NPU 组合平台，给出明确的面积、功耗与推理加速数据，对边缘 AI 硬件选型有参考价值。

item.title: Nvidia Halts H200 AI Chip Shipments to China
item.description:
Interim CEO Colette Kress confirmed on the earnings call that Nvidia has stopped shipping licensed Hopper data center products to China, with guidance no longer including that revenue. The move follows White House approval for H200 exports that Beijing never matched with import clearance, leaving roughly 600,000 H200 chips stranded in Hong Kong and marking a sharp reversal of Nvidia's China strategy.

原文标题：英伟达停止向中国出货 H200 芯片

Why it matters：全球最大 AI 芯片供应商主动切断对华高端算力供给，直接重塑算力地缘格局与国产替代节奏。

item.title: Nvidia Posts $64.9B Quarterly Profit and Sets Neocloud Financing Rules
item.description:
Nvidia reported $64.9 billion in net income for its fiscal third quarter and for the first time publicly drew the line on how far it will finance neoclouds and AI data-center buildouts. The company had already backstopped OpenAI's $105 billion PORTS-Pike campus in Ohio, but new leadership signals that the freewheeling dealmaking era under Jensen Huang may be over.

原文标题：英伟达 Q3 净利 649 亿美元 明确新云融资边界

Why it matters：英伟达以千亿美元级担保深度介入 AI 基建融资，其融资口径变化直接影响算力供给与 neocloud 生态。

item.title: Tencent Says Chip Curbs Will Lengthen Next-Gen Model Training
item.description:
Tencent confirmed during its Q3 2026 earnings call that chip supply restrictions will extend the training timeline for its next-generation Hunyuan model. The company also reported revenue of RMB 207.3 billion, up 8% year over year, cloud revenue growth accelerating to 35%, and WorkBuddy surpassing 10 million daily active users. The disclosure signals that compute constraints are now materially shaping frontier model iteration cadence at China's leading AI firms.

原文标题：腾讯称芯片受限致下一代模型训练周期拉长

Why it matters：头部大厂首次在财报场合明确承认芯片限制拖慢前沿模型训练节奏，是观察算力约束如何影响模型迭代的关键产业信号。

item.title: Doubao Work Hits 8 Million DAU Three Months After Launch
item.description:
Doubao Work, ByteDance's productivity-focused AI product, surpassed 8 million daily active users and 2 billion RMB in enterprise ARR within three months of launch. The product autonomously decomposes natural-language tasks and calls tools, and a recent update added third-party models including Kimi K3.1 Pro, GLM 5.3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash alongside usage-based credit pricing.

原文标题：豆包工作上线三个月 DAU 突破 800 万

Why it matters：这是国内生产力型 AI 产品少见的规模化商业数据披露，且涉及多模型接入策略，对判断 Agent 产品落地节奏有参考价值。

item.title: Tencent WeChat Xiaowei Hits 30M DAU with Lower Inference Costs
item.description:
Tencent President Martin Lau said at an earnings call that WeChat's AI assistant Xiaowei has reached 30 million daily active users in its test pool, and its quarterly cost after full rollout will be lower than Yuanbao's earlier this year. Xiaowei runs on a custom WeLM model with 80B total and 3B activated parameters, with Tencent citing extremely low and falling inference costs and expecting some inference to move on-device.

原文标题：微信小微日活 3000 万 推理成本将低于元宝

Why it matters：腾讯首次给出微信 AI 助手的用户规模与成本量级，并透露端侧推理路线，是观察超级 App 内嵌大模型经济性的关键信号。

item.title: DeepSeek Scraps Search and Fetch Fees, Bills Only by Token Usage
item.description:
DeepSeek announced that starting 12:00 Beijing time on November 18, 2026, server-side search and web fetching triggered during model calls will no longer be billed separately, with charges based solely on model token usage. Previously the Search/Fetch APIs cost 5 yuan per 1,000 successful requests, so the change effectively lowers retrieval costs for agent and RAG applications.

原文标题：DeepSeek 取消搜索与抓取计费 仅按 Token 收费

Why it matters：联网检索从按次计费转为并入 Token，直接改变 Agent 与 RAG 应用的调用成本结构。

item.title: Unsiloed AI Raises $7.5M Seed to Make Enterprise Documents Agent-Readable
item.description:
Unsiloed AI has raised a $7.5 million seed round led by Felicis, with participation from Y Combinator, Orange Collective and Uncorrelated Ventures. Its software parses tables, charts and complex layouts into structured, traceable data that AI agents can consume, targeting high-stakes sectors such as banking, healthcare and law. The seven-person startup will use the funds to hire researchers and engineers, expand sales and build proprietary datasets.

原文标题：Unsiloed AI 获 750 万美元融资 让企业文档可被智能体读取

Why it matters：企业文档结构化是智能体落地的关键瓶颈，该融资反映了资本对这一数据层的关注。

item.title: India's Humyn Labs Raises $47M to Supply Robot Training Data
item.description:
India-based Humyn Labs has raised $47M in Series A funding, comprising $26M in equity led by Accel and $21M in venture debt led by Lighthouse Canton. The capital will scale real-world physical manipulation data collection for U.S. AI and robotics firms, addressing the embodied AI training data bottleneck.

原文标题：Humyn Labs 融资 4700 万美元为美国机器人公司供数据

Why it matters：具身智能数据供应链的关键融资事件，反映机器人训练数据采集正成为独立赛道。

item.title: Suno Launches Visuals to Turn AI Songs into Videos
item.description:
Suno has launched Visuals, letting users turn song sections into AI-generated clips of up to 15 seconds with automatic lyric lipsync, or generate cover art and thumbnails from prompts across web, iOS and Android. It marks Suno's push from music generation toward a multimodal content platform, even as community pushback over audio quality priorities grows louder.

原文标题：Suno 推出 Visuals 支持歌曲生成 AI 视频

Why it matters：音乐生成平台向视频多模态延伸的代表性产品动作，值得关注 AI 内容创作工具链的边界扩张。

item.title: Type Fighter 2 Turns Touch Typing Practice into an Arcade Game
item.description:
Type Fighter 2 is an arcade-inspired typing game aimed at people learning touch typing. It is free, requires no account, keeps progress locally, and works on mobile though a physical keyboard is recommended.

原文标题：Type Fighter 2 打字街机游戏上线

Why it matters：一款面向盲打练习的轻量开源风格小游戏，具备一定实用价值但技术增量有限。

item.title: WeChat AI Assistant Xiaowei Hits 30 Million Daily Active Users
item.description:
WeChat announced that its personal AI assistant Xiaowei has expanded its user testing and reached 30 million daily active users, gradually integrating into chats, Moments, official accounts and Channels. Built on a customized WeLM model optimized for cost efficiency, Xiaowei may offload some inference tasks to user devices in the future.

原文标题：微信 AI 助理小微日活达 3000 万

Why it matters：微信超级 App 内 AI 助理日活破 3000 万，是消费级 AI 分发规模的重要信号。

item.title: Anthropic Launches Record IPO at Up to $1.4 Trillion Valuation
item.description:
Anthropic is expected to go public on November 19 at a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion, potentially the largest IPO in history. Wall Street is already building hype, with at least seven issuers preparing 11 single-stock leveraged ETFs, while Vanda Research projects roughly $250 million in net retail buying, double the SpaceX IPO record. The listing is seen as a key test for reviving confidence in the AI sector, though it also highlights the allocation gap between institutions and retail investors.

原文标题：Anthropic 启动史上最大 IPO 估值或达 1.4 万亿美元

Why it matters：万亿级估值 IPO 将直接检验 AI 板块的资本市场信心，是行业走向的关键风向标。

item.title: Meituan Debuts Drone Delivery in Dubai with Tether-Drop Model
item.description:
Meituan unveiled its fourth-generation tether-drop drone, the M-Drone 4L, in Dubai, with routes set to open soon across communities such as Sobha Hartland. The aircraft uses autonomous drop-point selection, swing suppression and a six-axis force sensor with an electronic release hook for stable payload delivery, and has been tested from -20°C to 50°C in heavy rain and Dubai dust. Meituan's drone fleet has completed over 1.1 million orders worldwide across Shenzhen, Shanghai, Guangzhou and Hong Kong.

原文标题：美团无人机索降机型出海 迪拜航线即将投用

Why it matters：中国无人机配送方案首次规模化落地中东，是具身智能与低空物流出海的重要产业信号。

item.title: Suno 推出 Visuals 功能 为 AI 音乐生成配套视频
item.description:
Suno 上线 Visuals 功能，可基于 MiniMax H3 定制模型 H3 Move 为歌曲生成最长 15 秒的配套视频，支持歌词同步、唇形同步与时间线延展。该功能覆盖 Web、iOS 与 Android，并通过过滤与内嵌水印应对版权风险。

Why it matters：音乐生成平台向多模态内容生产延伸，且明确采用中国开源视频模型定制，具备产品与技术选型双重参考价值。

item.title: Osmo 发布首个嗅觉基础模型 达到人类水平
item.description:
AI 初创公司 Osmo 宣称其嗅觉基础模型已达到“人类水平嗅觉智能”，即在气味检测与辨别上接近普通人，在气味创造上接近初级调香师。公司通过约 30 名专业嗅辨员对海量气味进行人工标注，并结合化学分析构建训练数据集，目标是让计算机具备嗅觉能力。

Why it matters：嗅觉基础模型是 AI 感知模态的重要新方向，具备明确的技术增量与产业想象空间。

item.title: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol 两款模型
item.description:
OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol 两款模型，Astra 在 Intelligence Index 上得分 62，仅次于 Anthropic 的 Fable 5.2（65 分），而 Sol 以约 Astra 15% 的单任务成本达到同等水平，使 OpenAI 在“单位美元智能”上占据明显优势。发布时机选在 Anthropic 预期首个交易日的前两天，但新模型在意见领袖圈层遭遇较强负面反馈，OpenAI 方面已作出防御性回应。

Why it matters：头部厂商同日发布双模型并重塑性价比曲线，是值得关注的模型竞争节点。

item.title: 智元长隆乐园部署近 500 台人形机器人
item.description:
智元合伙人王闯在 APEC 财经之夜透露，智元与长隆共建的具身智能主题乐园自 9 月开园以来已部署近 500 台机器人，覆盖 100 余个岗位，预计年底达到 1000 台规模。他强调人形机器人的核心价值在于真正完成实际工作，而非仅具备行走与对话能力。

Why it matters：这是人形机器人从演示走向规模化岗位部署的少见量化案例，值得关注落地进展。

item.title: Gemini 4 Neon 模型标识曝光 或绑定全新订阅层级
item.description:
开发者在 Gemini 网页应用代码中发现 gemini-4-neon 模型标识，与已发布的 Argon、Carbon、Hydrogen 并列，暗示 Google 正筹备第四款 Gemini 4 系列模型。代码同时出现 TIER_NEON 订阅层级，内部标记为 Gemini Ultra 的变体并关联付费升级逻辑，但官方尚未公布任何参数或能力细节。

Why it matters：代码泄露揭示 Google Gemini 4 系列新成员与订阅体系变动，属产品路线早期信号，但缺乏实质参数与官方确认。

item.title: 能量推理器实现 385 倍推理效率提升
item.description:
研究者提出能量推理器（EBRs），在潜空间上学习能量函数，将循环推理更新形式化为能量梯度下降，并利用能量值作为停止信号。在四个算法推理基准上，EBRs 匹配或超越现有循环推理模型，在 Sudoku-Extreme 上以 99.9% 准确率实现 345 倍推理算力节省，并在多解任务上达到最优解覆盖率。

Why it matters：以能量函数显式引导循环推理并给出停止信号，在硬推理基准上实现数量级推理算力节省，对推理架构研究有直接参考价值。
